items.name: three_interwoven_ribbons
items.prompt: Exactly three LONG flexible cloth bands colored red, blue, and yellow. All THREE bands are TOGETHER interwoven in ONE shared three-strand braid from left to right, with multiple alternating over-and-under crossings. Every red segment connects to the same red ribbon, blue to blue, yellow to yellow. SIX loose ends visible (3 at left, 3 at right). No separate braids. Flat-lay product photo, uniform pale surface, sharp weave detail.

items.name: three_people_carrying_table
items.prompt: EXACTLY THREE movers, not four: two adults wearing blue shirts at lower-left end and one adult wearing red shirt at upper-right end. All three are jointly LIFTING ONE heavy rectangular WOODEN TABLE up a staircase, touching its edges with both hands. There are only three people in the entire scene, full-body view, four table legs all visible and off ground. The workers are not sitting and the table is not resting on its legs. Cinematic photojournalism.

items.name: penrose_impossible_stairs
items.prompt: A physically impossible Penrose staircase loop, Escher ascending descending staircase, consisting of EXACTLY FOUR stair flights making a complete connected rectangular ring around a square hole. All stairs apparently go UP in clockwise order, yet the fourth flight meets the first at the same level. Very specific impossible perspective optical illusion, a closed ascending spiral with no end. Isometric 3/4 view of ancient stone stairs, all four corners connected, image clearly shows full stair loop.
